history.perspective: B19 - Offline/airplane-mode behavior on every network-touching screen
history.outcome: clean, live-verified by overriding window.fetch to simulate true offline. Never-fetched and previously-fetched content both degrade gracefully (clear error text, no crash). Traced the disk-cache miss to its root cause: expo-file-system has NO web implementation (official stub, console.warn + no-op), a verification-environment limitation not an app bug - readThrough's try/catch already handles it correctly, and this should genuinely work on real devices.
